evals.prompt: Prüf mal meine API-Nutzung. Der Code liegt in evals/fixtures/bad, das ist eine Next.js App, die einen bezahlten Text-Dienst anbindet. Warum ist die Rechnung so hoch und ist das sicher?
evals.expected_output: Mode A audit: runs scripts/api_scan.py first, then findings in the Finding format across all four levels with severity, file:line, abuse scenario with a rough number, and before/after TypeScript; closes with the summary block, top-3 priorities and an estimated saving.
expectations: Runs scripts/api_scan.py on the fixture before judging, and names the post-build bundle grep as the remaining proof
CRITICAL: NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENAI_API_KEY plus a direct fetch to api.openai.com inside a "use client" component; correction moves the call to a route and says to rotate the key
CRITICAL/HIGH: POST /api/generate has no auth and no rate limit before a paid upstream call; correction shows the order auth -> validation -> limit -> call
HIGH: model and max_tokens are taken from the request body; correction replaces them with a server-side tier allowlist
MEDIUM: fetch without AbortSignal.timeout, retryForever without backoff or bound, useEffect without dependency array, setInterval polling every second
LOW: await inside the for loop over prompts (N+1) and onChange without debounce
Summary block with counts per severity, top 3, and a quantified saving estimate
Ends with the self-reflection checklist answered

evals.prompt: Schreib mir eine Server Action analyseText(input: string), die den Text an unseren Anthropic-Client schickt und die Antwort zurückgibt. Wir nutzen Next.js 16 und Supabase.
evals.expected_output: Mode B: delivers the action with the four-step order built in (requireUser, Zod size limit, checkLimit with a daily quota, timeout on the SDK call, no client-controlled model or max_tokens), then a short '--- API notes ---' block only for MEDIUM+ items, without interrupting the flow.
expectations: Auth check is the first statement, validation with a max length follows, then the limit, then the paid call
Uses a multi-instance-safe limiter (Upstash or Postgres upsert), not an in-memory Map, and mentions the daily quota
Model and max_tokens are fixed server-side; the client cannot pass them
Notes the Supabase key rule (publishable in the client with RLS, secret server-only) only if a Supabase client is created
Compact API notes block at the end, no full audit

evals.prompt: Das Autocomplete in der Feldsuche fühlt sich langsam an und wir zahlen viel für die Geocoding-API. Was kann ich tun, ohne dass sich die Ergebnisse ändern?
evals.expected_output: Level 4 walk in order: dedupe in-flight requests, debounce 300 ms plus min 3 characters plus AbortController, persistent cache keyed by input hash with a long TTL for geocoding, batching if lists are involved; each item with before/after code and a quantified effect like the example in efficiency-and-cost.md; explicitly states that the output stays identical.
expectations: Follows the stage order from Level 4 and reads references/efficiency-and-cost.md
Recommends a persistent cache for geocoding (days to unbounded TTL), not only an in-memory map
Includes the debounce plus min-length plus abort pattern with code
Closes with a before/after number (e.g. ~90% fewer calls) and the statement that results are unchanged
